game.desc: Kingdom under Fire: Circle of Doom on Xbox 360 is an action game with some role-playing elements focused on character development. Choose from 6 heroes, each wielding 5 to 6 types of weapons, learn over 60 spells and 50 skills to defend yourself in randomly generated dungeons to fight against evil creatures.
